trans-unit.source: Pipe network carries multiple fluids ({0}). Output halted — keep each fluid on its own network.
trans-unit.target: Мережа труб містить кілька рідин ({0}). Вихід зупинено — тримайте кожну рідину в окремій мережі.

trans-unit.id: No pipe connected to the {0} output.
trans-unit.source: No pipe connected to the {0} output.

trans-unit.id: No demand for {0} right now — idling to save resources.
trans-unit.source: No demand for {0} right now — idling to save resources.
trans-unit.target: Зараз немає попиту на {0} — простій задля економії ресурсів.

trans-unit.id: {0} supply too weak — halted: only {1} of {2}/s ({3}), under the {4} minimum to run. Feed it more — a stronger or extra pump, or a shorter/wider pipe run.
trans-unit.source: {0} supply too weak — halted: only {1} of {2}/s ({3}), under the {4} minimum to run. Feed it more — a stronger or extra pump, or a shorter/wider pipe run.

trans-unit.id: {0} supply is the bottleneck: only {1} of {2}/s ({3}). Feed it more — a stronger or extra pump, or a shorter/wider pipe run — to reach full speed.
trans-unit.source: {0} supply is the bottleneck: only {1} of {2}/s ({3}). Feed it more — a stronger or extra pump, or a shorter/wider pipe run — to reach full speed.

trans-unit.id: Holding {0}: the {1} it converts into can't be processed or pushed out right now.
trans-unit.source: Holding {0}: the {1} it converts into can't be processed or pushed out right now.

trans-unit.id: Wrong fluid: {0} is connected, but this requires {1}.
trans-unit.source: Wrong fluid: {0} is connected, but this requires {1}.

trans-unit.id: {0} throughput below {1} ({2} of {3}/s) — intake paused until it recovers.
trans-unit.source: {0} throughput below {1} ({2} of {3}/s) — intake paused until it recovers.

trans-unit.id: {0} flowing at {1} of {2} L/s — operating at {3}.
trans-unit.source: {0} flowing at {1} of {2} L/s — operating at {3}.

trans-unit.id: {0} flowing at {1} (of max {2}) liters per second.
trans-unit.source: {0} flowing at {1} (of max {2}) liters per second.
trans-unit.target: {0} тече зі швидкістю {1} (з макс. {2}) літрів за секунду.

trans-unit.id: You are not authorized to use this store.
trans-unit.source: You are not authorized to use this store.
trans-unit.target: Ви не маєте права користуватися цим магазином.

trans-unit.id: Limited storage: the store can't fit everything it wants to buy.
trans-unit.source: Limited storage: the store can't fit everything it wants to buy.

trans-unit.id: Limited funds: the store can't afford everything it wants to buy.
trans-unit.source: Limited funds: the store can't afford everything it wants to buy.

trans-unit.id: In-world sale: a placed object sold where it stands, not goods in a store.
trans-unit.source: In-world sale: a placed object sold where it stands, not goods in a store.

trans-unit.id: This amendment would remove every article from the constitution, leaving the settlement with no authority. Add a replacement article before removing the last one.
trans-unit.source: This amendment would remove every article from the constitution, leaving the settlement with no authority. Add a replacement article before removing the last one.
trans-unit.target: Ця поправка вилучила б з конституції всі статті, залишивши поселення без жодних повноважень. Додайте нову статтю, перш ніж вилучати останню.

trans-unit.id: for the selected profession (none selected yet)
trans-unit.source: for the selected profession (none selected yet)

trans-unit.target: Очікує знезараження — ґрунт: {0}, важкі мінерали: {1}, хімікати: {2}

trans-unit.id: {0} halted. No linked storage can take {1}, please release space in attached inventories or collect manually.
trans-unit.source: {0} halted. No linked storage can take {1}, please release space in attached inventories or collect manually.
trans-unit.target: {0} зупинено. Жодне під'єднане сховище не може прийняти {1}; звільніть місце в під'єднаних інвентарях або заберіть вручну.

trans-unit.id: Carry this block's material and select a shape to swap the block to.
trans-unit.source: Carry this block's material and select a shape to swap the block to.

trans-unit.id: Remove the routed pipe before changing this block's shape.
trans-unit.source: Remove the routed pipe before changing this block's shape.
trans-unit.target: Приберіть прокладену трубу, перш ніж змінювати форму цього блока.

trans-unit.id: Can't change the shape of a block within another world object.
trans-unit.source: Can't change the shape of a block within another world object.
trans-unit.target: Неможливо змінити форму блока всередині іншого об'єкта світу.

trans-unit.id: You don't meet the requirements to build this shape.
trans-unit.source: You don't meet the requirements to build this shape.
trans-unit.target: Ви не відповідаєте вимогам для будівництва цієї форми.

trans-unit.id: The block already has this shape.
trans-unit.source: The block already has this shape.

trans-unit.id: Cannot pick up while recycling an item.
trans-unit.source: Cannot pick up while recycling an item.
trans-unit.target: Неможливо підняти під час переробки предмета.

trans-unit.id: Waste containment: {0} of stored pollution retained.
trans-unit.source: Waste containment: {0} of stored pollution retained.

trans-unit.id: Missing {0} — fluid is being relayed through unfiltered.
trans-unit.source: Missing {0} — fluid is being relayed through unfiltered.
trans-unit.target: Бракує {0} — рідина пропускається далі без фільтрації.

trans-unit.id: Missing {0} — filter stopped, holding the fluid back.
trans-unit.source: Missing {0} — filter stopped, holding the fluid back.

trans-unit.id: stopping and holding the fluid back.
trans-unit.source: stopping and holding the fluid back.

trans-unit.id: Star investments are permanent and can't be cleared.
trans-unit.source: Star investments are permanent and can't be cleared.
trans-unit.target: Вкладені зірки є незворотними, і скинути їх не можна.

trans-unit.id: {0} already has all the stars it needs.
trans-unit.source: {0} already has all the stars it needs.

trans-unit.id: You have no stars available to invest.
trans-unit.source: You have no stars available to invest.
trans-unit.target: У вас немає доступних зірок для вкладення.

trans-unit.id: Invest 1 star into {0}? ({1}/{2} invested so far). Stars invested here are not refundable.
trans-unit.source: Invest 1 star into {0}? ({1}/{2} invested so far). Stars invested here are not refundable.
trans-unit.target: Вкласти 1 зірку в {0}? (вкладено {1}/{2}). Вкладені сюди зірки не повертаються.

trans-unit.id: Benefits are inactive until all requirements are met.
trans-unit.source: Benefits are inactive until all requirements are met.
trans-unit.target: Переваги неактивні, доки не виконано всі вимоги.

trans-unit.id: Hold Ctrl to temporarily display the last layer you selected, release it to restore the current view.
trans-unit.source: Hold Ctrl to temporarily display the last layer you selected, release it to restore the current view.
trans-unit.target: Утримуйте Ctrl, щоб тимчасово показати останній вибраний шар; відпустіть, щоб повернути поточний вигляд.

trans-unit.id: Bring this inventory to the top of the storage view
trans-unit.source: Bring this inventory to the top of the storage view
trans-unit.target: Перемістити цей інвентар угору списку сховищ

trans-unit.id: Fraction of a consumed ingredient's SalvageCost that becomes garbage during crafting. 0.2 means 20% of the recycle value is produced as waste per unit of ingredient consumed.
trans-unit.source: Fraction of a consumed ingredient's SalvageCost that becomes garbage during crafting. 0.2 means 20% of the recycle value is produced as waste per unit of ingredient consumed.
trans-unit.target: Частка вартості розбирання витраченого інгредієнта, що перетворюється на сміття під час крафту. 0.2 означає, що на кожну витрачену одиницю інгредієнта утворюється 20% його переробної вартості як відходи.

trans-unit.id: Stop the sun where it currently is, for every player.
trans-unit.source: Stop the sun where it currently is, for every player.
trans-unit.target: Зупиняє сонце там, де воно зараз, для всіх гравців.

trans-unit.id: Start the sun moving again from where it was stopped, for every player.
trans-unit.source: Start the sun moving again from where it was stopped, for every player.
trans-unit.target: Знову запускає рух сонця з місця зупинки для всіх гравців.

trans-unit.id: Put the sky back on the world clock, for every player.
trans-unit.source: Put the sky back on the world clock, for every player.
trans-unit.target: Повертає небо до світового годинника для всіх гравців.

trans-unit.id: Move the sun to noon for every player.
trans-unit.source: Move the sun to noon for every player.
trans-unit.target: Переміщує сонце на полудень для всіх гравців.

trans-unit.id: Move the sun to midnight for every player.
trans-unit.source: Move the sun to midnight for every player.
trans-unit.target: Переміщує сонце на північ для всіх гравців.

trans-unit.id: Move the sun to the specified hour for every player.
trans-unit.source: Move the sun to the specified hour for every player.
trans-unit.target: Переміщує сонце на вказану годину для всіх гравців.

trans-unit.id: List of commands to change the time of day for yourself only.
trans-unit.source: List of commands to change the time of day for yourself only.
trans-unit.target: Список команд для зміни часу доби лише для вас.

trans-unit.id: Stop the sun where it currently is, for you only.
trans-unit.source: Stop the sun where it currently is, for you only.
trans-unit.target: Зупиняє сонце там, де воно зараз, лише для вас.

trans-unit.id: Start your sun moving again from where you stopped it.
trans-unit.source: Start your sun moving again from where you stopped it.
trans-unit.target: Знову запускає рух вашого сонця з місця, де ви його зупинили.

trans-unit.id: Put your sky back on the shared world time.
trans-unit.source: Put your sky back on the shared world time.
trans-unit.target: Повертає ваше небо до спільного світового часу.

trans-unit.id: Move the sun to noon, for you only.
trans-unit.source: Move the sun to noon, for you only.
trans-unit.target: Переміщує сонце на полудень лише для вас.

trans-unit.id: Move the sun to midnight, for you only.
trans-unit.source: Move the sun to midnight, for you only.
trans-unit.target: Переміщує сонце на північ лише для вас.

trans-unit.id: Move the sun to the specified hour, for you only.
trans-unit.source: Move the sun to the specified hour, for you only.
trans-unit.target: Переміщує сонце на вказану годину лише для вас.

trans-unit.id: List of commands to change the weather for yourself only.
trans-unit.source: List of commands to change the weather for yourself only.
trans-unit.target: Список команд для зміни погоди лише для вас.

trans-unit.id: Clear the weather, for you only.
trans-unit.source: Clear the weather, for you only.
trans-unit.target: Робить погоду ясною лише для вас.

trans-unit.id: Create a light rain, for you only.
trans-unit.source: Create a light rain, for you only.
trans-unit.target: Викликає легкий дощ лише для вас.

trans-unit.id: Create a heavy rain storm, for you only.
trans-unit.source: Create a heavy rain storm, for you only.
trans-unit.target: Викликає сильну зливу лише для вас.

trans-unit.id: Create some clouds, for you only.
trans-unit.source: Create some clouds, for you only.

trans-unit.id: Create some fog, for you only.
trans-unit.source: Create some fog, for you only.

trans-unit.id: Put your weather back on the shared server weather.
trans-unit.source: Put your weather back on the shared server weather.
trans-unit.target: Повертає вашу погоду до спільної погоди сервера.

trans-unit.id: The catalyst this filter consumes: how many are stocked in the linked inventories, and the charge left on the loaded one.
trans-unit.source: The catalyst this filter consumes: how many are stocked in the linked inventories, and the charge left on the loaded one.
trans-unit.target: Каталізатор, який споживає цей фільтр: скільки його є в під'єднаних інвентарях і скільки заряду залишилося в завантаженому.

trans-unit.id: Solid byproducts captured by this filter: each fills up as fluid is processed and is emitted as a block when full.
trans-unit.source: Solid byproducts captured by this filter: each fills up as fluid is processed and is emitted as a block when full.
trans-unit.target: Тверді побічні продукти, вловлені цим фільтром: кожен накопичується під час обробки рідини й виходить блоком, коли заповниться.

trans-unit.id: Skip the hourly stats squash while online player count exceeds this, since the LiteDB churn it causes competes with live gameplay for GC time. Set to 0 to disable.
trans-unit.source: Skip the hourly stats squash while online player count exceeds this, since the LiteDB churn it causes competes with live gameplay for GC time. Set to 0 to disable.
trans-unit.target: Пропускати щогодинне ущільнення статистики, доки кількість гравців онлайн перевищує це значення, бо навантаження на LiteDB конкурує з живим геймплеєм за час збирача сміття. Значення 0 вимикає.

trans-unit.id: Even if the server stays busy, force a squash after this many hours so the backlog can't grow unbounded.
trans-unit.source: Even if the server stays busy, force a squash after this many hours so the backlog can't grow unbounded.
trans-unit.target: Навіть якщо сервер лишається завантаженим, примусово виконати ущільнення після цієї кількості годин, щоб черга не зростала безмежно.

trans-unit.id: Sets a pollution layer value (soil/heavymineral/chemical/acidrain), on your claim or on every claim within a radius.
trans-unit.source: Sets a pollution layer value (soil/heavymineral/chemical/acidrain), on your claim or on every claim within a radius.
trans-unit.target: Задає значення шару забруднення (soil/heavymineral/chemical/acidrain) на вашій ділянці або на всіх ділянках у радіусі.

trans-unit.id: Removes all pollution of one layer (soil/heavymineral/chemical/acidrain), on your claim or within a radius.
trans-unit.source: Removes all pollution of one layer (soil/heavymineral/chemical/acidrain), on your claim or within a radius.
trans-unit.target: Прибирає все забруднення одного шару (soil/heavymineral/chemical/acidrain) на вашій ділянці або в радіусі.

trans-unit.id: Queues decontamination of a pollution layer (soil/heavymineral/chemical), on your claim or within a radius.
trans-unit.source: Queues decontamination of a pollution layer (soil/heavymineral/chemical), on your claim or within a radius.
trans-unit.target: Ставить у чергу знезараження шару забруднення (soil/heavymineral/chemical) на вашій ділянці або в радіусі.

trans-unit.id: Sets the queued decontamination (soil/heavymineral/chemical), on your claim or within a radius.
trans-unit.source: Sets the queued decontamination (soil/heavymineral/chemical), on your claim or within a radius.
trans-unit.target: Задає знезараження в черзі (soil/heavymineral/chemical) на вашій ділянці або в радіусі.

trans-unit.id: Waste product from concentrating ore. When stored improperly the run-off will create heavy mineral pollution; killing nearby plants and seeping into the water supply. Burying it does nothing; only sealed containment holds it back.
trans-unit.source: Waste product from concentrating ore. When stored improperly the run-off will create heavy mineral pollution; killing nearby plants and seeping into the water supply. Burying it does nothing; only sealed containment holds it back.
trans-unit.target: Відхід від збагачення руди. Якщо зберігати неналежно, стоки створять забруднення важкими мінералами: рослини поблизу гинуть, а забруднення просочується у воду. Закопування не допомагає — стримати його може лише герметичне зберігання.

trans-unit.id: A heap of generic, worthless leftovers — none of it valuable enough to recover. Unsightly and a source of soil pollution; burying it does nothing, store it in proper garbage containment to hold the effect back.
trans-unit.source: A heap of generic, worthless leftovers — none of it valuable enough to recover. Unsightly and a source of soil pollution; burying it does nothing, store it in proper garbage containment to hold the effect back.
trans-unit.target: Купа звичайних непотрібних решток — нічого цінного, що варто було б вилучити. Псує вигляд і забруднює ґрунт; закопування не допомагає, тож зберігайте в належному контейнері для сміття, щоб стримати ефект.

trans-unit.id: A mix of electronic scrap, requires further processing through a recycler to retrieve precious minerals.
trans-unit.source: A mix of electronic scrap, requires further processing through a recycler to retrieve precious minerals.
trans-unit.target: Суміш електронного брухту; потребує подальшої обробки в переробнику, щоб вилучити цінні мінерали.

trans-unit.id: Can you carry as much as a bear! Not really, but it helps you carry more.
trans-unit.source: Can you carry as much as a bear! Not really, but it helps you carry more.
trans-unit.target: Чи зможете ви нести стільки ж, скільки ведмідь? Не зовсім, але це допоможе нести більше.

trans-unit.id: A survival backpack that offers more support than the basic backpack.
trans-unit.source: A survival backpack that offers more support than the basic backpack.
trans-unit.target: Рюкзак для виживання, що підтримує краще за базовий.

trans-unit.id: Snug work boots with side zippers.
trans-unit.source: Snug work boots with side zippers.
trans-unit.target: Зручні робочі черевики з бічними блискавками.

trans-unit.id: Also called chapeau a bec, or Billed Hat in France due to its bird-beak like appearance.
trans-unit.source: Also called chapeau a bec, or Billed Hat in France due to its bird-beak like appearance.
trans-unit.target: Також відомий як chapeau à bec, або «дзьобатий капелюх» у Франції — через схожість на пташиний дзьоб.

trans-unit.id: A steel hardhat with a light source for the darkest places.
trans-unit.source: A steel hardhat with a light source for the darkest places.
trans-unit.target: Сталева каска з ліхтарем для найтемніших місць.

trans-unit.id: Boots with rubber soles and thermal insulation for comfort while staying durable.
trans-unit.source: Boots with rubber soles and thermal insulation for comfort while staying durable.
trans-unit.target: Черевики з гумовою підошвою та термоізоляцією — зручні й водночас міцні.

trans-unit.id: Waterproof rubber sole boots with synthetic lining that provides protection against the elements when working in the fields.
trans-unit.source: Waterproof rubber sole boots with synthetic lining that provides protection against the elements when working in the fields.
trans-unit.target: Водонепроникні черевики з гумовою підошвою та синтетичною підкладкою, що захищають від негоди під час роботи в полі.

trans-unit.id: A wide-brimmed straw hat designed to provide protection from the sun.
trans-unit.source: A wide-brimmed straw hat designed to provide protection from the sun.
trans-unit.target: Солом'яний капелюх із широкими крисами, що захищає від сонця.

trans-unit.id: An iron hardhat with a light source for the darkest places.
trans-unit.source: An iron hardhat with a light source for the darkest places.
trans-unit.target: Залізна каска з ліхтарем для найтемніших місць.

trans-unit.id: Basic footwear that helps reduce the strain of walking longer distances.
trans-unit.source: Basic footwear that helps reduce the strain of walking longer distances.
trans-unit.target: Базове взуття, що зменшує втому від довгих переходів.

trans-unit.id: Comfortable sandals with extra traction to avoid slipping.
trans-unit.source: Comfortable sandals with extra traction to avoid slipping.

trans-unit.id: Organic remediation blend that helps soil recover from light (Trash/sewage) pollution. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Soil Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.source: Organic remediation blend that helps soil recover from light (Trash/sewage) pollution. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Soil Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.target: Органічна суміш для відновлення, що допомагає ґрунту оговтатися від легкого забруднення (сміття/стоки). Застосуйте до будь-якого блока землі чи споруди на ділянці: одна одиниця нейтралізує одну одиницю джерела забруднення ґрунту, і кожні 24 години діє половина знезаражувача, що очікує на території.

trans-unit.id: Mineral binder that immobilizes heavy-metal contamination ? the only way down once a claim passes the self-cleaning ceiling. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Heavy Mineral Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.source: Mineral binder that immobilizes heavy-metal contamination ? the only way down once a claim passes the self-cleaning ceiling. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Heavy Mineral Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.target: Мінеральний зв'язувач, що знерухомлює забруднення важкими металами — єдиний спосіб знизити його, коли ділянка перевищила межу самоочищення. Застосуйте до будь-якого блока землі чи споруди на ділянці: одна одиниця нейтралізує одну одиницю джерела забруднення важкими мінералами, і кожні 24 години діє половина знезаражувача, що очікує на території.

trans-unit.id: Industrial reagent that neutralizes toxic chemical contamination. Costly to produce, but the only way to recover land past the chemical self-cleaning ceiling. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Chemical Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.source: Industrial reagent that neutralizes toxic chemical contamination. Costly to produce, but the only way to recover land past the chemical self-cleaning ceiling. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Chemical Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.target: Промисловий реагент, що нейтралізує токсичне хімічне забруднення. Дорогий у виробництві, але це єдиний спосіб відновити землю за межею хімічного самоочищення. Застосуйте до будь-якого блока землі чи споруди на ділянці: одна одиниця нейтралізує одну одиницю джерела хімічного забруднення, і кожні 24 години діє половина знезаражувача, що очікує на території.

trans-unit.id: A crude open dump for garbage. It holds a lot, but nothing stops the waste from seeping into the ground.
trans-unit.source: A crude open dump for garbage. It holds a lot, but nothing stops the waste from seeping into the ground.
trans-unit.target: Примітивний відкритий смітник. Вміщує багато, але ніщо не заважає відходам просочуватися в землю.

trans-unit.id: If true, world objects are only persisted when their state actually changed instead of on every tick. Turn off to restore legacy behavior where every ticking object is re-saved each cycle.
trans-unit.source: If true, world objects are only persisted when their state actually changed instead of on every tick. Turn off to restore legacy behavior where every ticking object is re-saved each cycle.
trans-unit.target: Якщо ввімкнено, об'єкти світу зберігаються лише тоді, коли їхній стан справді змінився, а не на кожному такті. Вимкніть, щоб повернути стару поведінку, коли кожен активний об'єкт перезаписується щоцикла.

trans-unit.id: Minutes between reconciliation sweeps that detect and persist state changed without a dirty mark (safety net for mods writing serialized fields directly). 0 disables the sweep.
trans-unit.source: Minutes between reconciliation sweeps that detect and persist state changed without a dirty mark (safety net for mods writing serialized fields directly). 0 disables the sweep.
trans-unit.target: Хвилин між звірками, які виявляють і зберігають зміни стану без позначки «змінено» (запобіжник для модів, що записують серіалізовані поля напряму). 0 вимикає звірку.

trans-unit.id: QA option: run the dirty-tracking reconciliation on every persist cycle and report each divergence. Expensive, only enable to hunt missing dirty marks.
trans-unit.source: QA option: run the dirty-tracking reconciliation on every persist cycle and report each divergence. Expensive, only enable to hunt missing dirty marks.
trans-unit.target: Опція для тестування: виконувати звірку відстеження змін на кожному циклі збереження й повідомляти про кожне розходження. Витратна; вмикайте лише для пошуку пропущених позначок змін.

trans-unit.id: EXPERIMENTAL. Use server garbage collection: much better multi-core utilization at the cost of higher memory usage. If your server hangs at boot and doesn't initialize or you notice other issues, try to turn this setting off first. Not recommended when several servers share one machine. The -servergc=true/false launch argument overrides this. Takes effect after server restart.
trans-unit.source: EXPERIMENTAL. Use server garbage collection: much better multi-core utilization at the cost of higher memory usage. If your server hangs at boot and doesn't initialize or you notice other issues, try to turn this setting off first. Not recommended when several servers share one machine. The -servergc=true/false launch argument overrides this. Takes effect after server restart.
trans-unit.target: ЕКСПЕРИМЕНТАЛЬНО. Використовувати серверний збирач сміття: значно краще використання багатоядерності ціною більшого споживання пам'яті. Якщо сервер зависає на запуску й не ініціалізується або ви помічаєте інші проблеми, спершу спробуйте вимкнути це налаштування. Не рекомендовано, коли кілька серверів працюють на одній машині. Аргумент запуску -servergc=true/false має вищий пріоритет. Діє після перезапуску сервера.

trans-unit.id: EXPERIMENTAL. Raise the minimum thread pool size so bursts of parallel work are not throttled while the pool grows. If your server hangs at boot and doesn't initialize or you notice other issues, try to turn this setting off first. Not recommended when several servers share one machine. The -threadboost=true/false launch argument overrides this. Takes effect after server restart.
trans-unit.source: EXPERIMENTAL. Raise the minimum thread pool size so bursts of parallel work are not throttled while the pool grows. If your server hangs at boot and doesn't initialize or you notice other issues, try to turn this setting off first. Not recommended when several servers share one machine. Якщо сервер зависає на запуску й не ініціалізується або ви помічаєте інші проблеми, спершу спробуйте вимкнути це налаштування. Не рекомендовано, коли кілька серверів працюють на одній машині. Аргумент запуску -threadboost=true/false має вищий пріоритет. Діє після перезапуску сервера.

trans-unit.id: Blocks must stay connected to the ground. A block that no longer touches the ground through other blocks falls: natural blocks fall as they are, constructed blocks fall and turn into garbage (see Salvage Share). Sideways connections count, so a bridge anchored at one end is still connected: whether it can actually hold is up to Constructed Blocks Need Support.
trans-unit.source: Blocks must stay connected to the ground. A block that no longer touches the ground through other blocks falls: natural blocks fall as they are, constructed blocks fall and turn into garbage (see Salvage Share). Sideways connections count, so a bridge anchored at one end is still connected: whether it can actually hold is up to Constructed Blocks Need Support.

trans-unit.id: Constructed blocks must hold themselves up, with two numbers shown in each block's tooltip. Horizontal support: how many blocks out a block can stick out sideways (held from the side or hanging) from a column standing on the ground. Supported weight: how much structural weight piled on it a block can carry, less the further out it is. A block past its horizontal support, or carrying more than it supports, cracks, then breaks with everything it was holding. A block resting on the block under it has no horizontal limit. Weight only goes down, toward the ground, through the blocks holding it. Building against rock anchors a construction; loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) does not. Natural blocks set on a construction, like a field on a roof, weigh on it.
trans-unit.source: Constructed blocks must hold themselves up, with two numbers shown in each block's tooltip. Horizontal support: how many blocks out a block can stick out sideways (held from the side or hanging) from a column standing on the ground. Supported weight: how much structural weight piled on it a block can carry, less the further out it is. A block past its horizontal support, or carrying more than it supports, cracks, then breaks with everything it was holding. A block resting on the block under it has no horizontal limit. Weight only goes down, toward the ground, through the blocks holding it. Building against rock anchors a construction; loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) does not. Natural blocks set on a construction, like a field on a roof, weigh on it.

trans-unit.id: Natural blocks that do not rest on solid ground all the way down (cave ceilings, overhangs, the rock above a tunnel) follow the horizontal support rule of constructed blocks with each rock's own horizontal support: a ceiling spans about twice it. Constructions standing on the ground hold them up, so pillars and props save a mine. Loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) keeps a slope: a free-standing pile higher than 2 blocks slides down, unless it rests on a rock or masonry ledge or is wedged between two solids. Fallen blocks keep their type. When off, natural blocks only fall when they are disconnected (see Disconnected Blocks Fall).
trans-unit.source: Natural blocks that do not rest on solid ground all the way down (cave ceilings, overhangs, the rock above a tunnel) follow the horizontal support rule of constructed blocks with each rock's own horizontal support: a ceiling spans about twice it. Constructions standing on the ground hold them up, so pillars and props save a mine. Loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) keeps a slope: a free-standing pile higher than 2 blocks slides down, unless it rests on a rock or masonry ledge or is wedged between two solids. Fallen blocks keep their type. When off, natural blocks only fall when they are disconnected (see Disconnected Blocks Fall).

trans-unit.id: Placed objects (tables, machines, storages) fall into a garbage bag, with all their contents, when the ground under them goes or when falling blocks land on them; the bag can be picked back up. When off, objects stay where they are, even in mid-air, and falling blocks land on top of them.

trans-unit.id: Rock standing on this many rock blocks counts as solid ground, for natural blocks and as an anchor for constructions: only the layers of rock just above a void can cave in, so a cave too wide brings down a slab this thick, then the next one over a narrower opening, until it settles into a vault, instead of the whole mountain above it. Loose ground never counts. 0: only rock in an unbroken column from bedrock is ground.
